newsitem.title: USA: Zapata to begin self-tender at $4.50/shr.
newsitem.headline: Zapata to begin self-tender at $4.50/shr.

text.p: Zapata Corp said it plans to begin a cash tender offer for up to 15 million shares of its common stock at a price of $4.50 per share.
The company said the offer will be conditioned upon a minimum of 10 million shares being tendered and not withdrawn and will be subject to the satisfaction of other customary conditions.
Zapata has approximately 29.5 million shares of common stock outstanding.

Avram Glazer, president and chief executive, said, "The board of directors has determined that the purchase of shares pursuant to the offer represents a good use of a substantial portion of the cash it has available and is an attractive investment opportunity for the company."
Zapata said chairman Malcolm Glazer intends to tender three million of the 10.4 million shares owned by him in the offering. The company intends to commence the tender offer in approximately a week.
